self_reflection_notes: Changed atom_index 2 tax_score from 0.85 to 1.0 and atom_score accordingly. However, this deviation is intentional prompt adherence ('two purple horses'), not a generation defect. The fine_grained_classifier still confidently identified 'sorrel' (logit 5.7), confirming the model recognized equine features despite non-standard coloring. Taxonomy scoring should evaluate whether the generated object matches its intended class identity, not whether it conforms to biological realism when the prompt explicitly requests fantasy elements.
